basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Project Technical Support Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Nephrology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, has invited applications for one Project Technical Support - I post (18000/- + HRA, as admissible) and one Project Technical Support - III post (28000/- + HRA, as admissible) under the ICMR-funded project "Early Versus Standard Discontinuation of CMV Prophylaxis Guided by CMV Cell-Mediated Immunity in Kidney Transplant Recipients: A Randomized Controlled Trial". Candidates must send a detailed CV to [email protected], mentioning the post, by 14 December 2026, 5:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Mention in the application the post you are applying for.
Send it so that it reaches by 14 December 2026, 5:00 PM.
The notice names no other document to attach and gives no separate application form.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi, is the institute issuing this notice. The posts sit in its Department of Nephrology and serve an ICMR-funded randomized controlled trial on discontinuing CMV prophylaxis in kidney transplant recipients.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces two vacancies in total. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no age cut-off date, no age relaxation and no desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / ITI or equivalent) + two years' experience in relevant subject / field. Or three years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + one year experience in relevant subject.

1. Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + three years post qualification experience, or PG in relevant subject / field. Or 2. For Engineering / IT / CS - four years Graduate Degree.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support - I carries a monthly salary of 18000/- + HRA, as admissible. Project Technical Support - III carries 28000/- + HRA, as admissible. The notice says no TA/DA will be given for the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV. Email the CV to [email protected] . Mention in the application the post you are applying for. Send it so that it reaches by 14 December 2026, 5:00 PM. The notice names no other document to attach and gives no separate application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview. The notice does not describe the shortlisting method, the interview date or the interview mode.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one for Project Technical Support - I and one for Project Technical Support - III, in the Department of Nephrology, AIIMS, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 14 December 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support - I?
faq.answer: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / ITI or equivalent) + two years' experience in relevant subject / field. Or three years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + one year experience in relevant subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + three years post qualification experience, or PG in relevant subject / field. For Engineering / IT / CS, a four years Graduate Degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years for Project Technical Support - I and 35 years for Project Technical Support - III, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Project Technical Support - I gets 18000/- + HRA, as admissible, per month. Project Technical Support - III gets 28000/- + HRA, as admissible, per month.

faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints the salary as 18000/- + HRA and 28000/- + HRA, as admissible, for the two posts respectively.

faq.answer: Send a detailed CV to [email protected], mentioning the post you apply for, by 14 December 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview, according to the notice.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be given for the interview.
